stepTitle: Two piloted satellites approach one another at a relative speed of $$0.250\,\text{m/s},$$ intending to dock. The first has a mass of $$4.00\times10**{3}\,\text{kg},$$ and the second a mass of $$7.50\times10**{3}\,\text{kg}.$$ Calculate the final velocity (after docking) by using the frame of reference in which the first satellite was originally at rest. Give the velocity to three significant figures (in $$\text{m/s})$$.
